raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "be the fastest internet provider"
      role subject ?p
      role location "Timișoara"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      compare any
      ?p equal "Digi"
      ?p equal "Orange"
      end
    end
  end

@q2 query
  select ?c
  where match
    relation "cost per month"
    role subject ?p
    role object ?c
    role location "Timișoara"
    polarity affirmed
  end
